apps.localizedDescription: Tonight’s tables, bills and menu for Ordinero restaurant owners.
apps.versionDescription: Faster loading: Tables, Menu and Overview now fetch their data at the same time instead of one call after another. On Tables, the open-bills count no longer shows stray asterisks, and long stays read in days ("22d 4h") instead of hundreds of hours.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ordinero uses the camera to scan the sign-in code on your dashboard, to take photos for your menu and to map your room for the table finder.
